# Databases — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

Database administration and design notes covering relational and NoSQL systems, SQL queries, schema design, indexing, and performance tuning.

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.
